svg.text: Every AI use case starts with a data product you haven't built yet.
Agent skills automate the heavy lifting. Engineers focus on judgment, quality, and business value.
Databases are not data products. Turning one into the other is where AI initiatives stall — and where Data Workbench starts.
THE DATABASE APPROACH — undocumented, ungoverned, no contract, no lineage
THE DATA PRODUCT APPROACH — contracted, governed, documented, AI-consumable
Rejections and edits train the system.
From source database to governed, marketplace-ready data product — measured in days, not months.
With full provenance, lineage, and human approval at every step.
How many AI-ready data products does your organization have today?
